sections.name: Official milXdy add-ons
sections.description: Maintainer-defined packages and candidates composed from this source checkout. The catalog never downloads or hot-loads package code.

packages.name: BOORU
packages.summary: A reviewed reaction-media discovery and picker capability planned for the Composer Kit package.

notes: Remibooru is the approved initial service candidate, but the Composer Kit package artifact and integrated QA gate are not complete.
No package hash or availability claim will be created by issue #181.

capabilities: Browse or search reviewed reaction-media metadata.
Open the canonical source page after an explicit user action.
Keep copy, save, attach, and composer handoff behind separate user review.

notes: These are proposed declarations only; no unavailable package expands extension permissions.

siteScopes: X/Twitter post and reply composer surfaces only

remoteServices.name: Remibooru
remoteServices.purpose: Public reaction-media metadata and thumbnail discovery.
remoteServices.dataSent: Explicit public search facets and pagination cursor only; no X account, draft, cookie, or authentication data.

notes: The proposed link-first cache contract remains owned by issue #17 and is not granted here.

privacyNotes: Thumbnails and metadata would be remote network requests only after the feature is explicitly enabled.
The proposed package must never transmit X account, composer, authentication, or browsing data.
Selecting media never posts, uploads, copies, saves, or attaches it automatically.

blockers.reason: Remote picker, attribution, caching, unavailable-source behavior, and explicit handoff remain under feature review.
Current release policy places BOORU inside the single Composer Kit package and requires integrated shared QA.

packages.name: Tweet Composer
packages.summary: A local-only typing helper that converts double dashes to em dashes in supported X/Twitter post composers.

notes: The package candidate preserves the built-in composerTools identity, storage key, enablement, lifecycle, X composer scope, and cleanup behavior.
Publication remains gated on cumulative QA and maintainer approval.

capabilities: Convert a typed double dash to an em dash.
Enable, disable, and reset the feature through Apps & Features.
Dispose its document listeners when disabled.

notes: Uses only the host permissions already present in the base extension.

siteScopes: Active X/Twitter post and reply composer textboxes
Excludes DMs, search boxes, native inputs, and textareas

notes: Preserves the built-in enablement key so disabling, updating, and rollback keep the user's setting.

privacyNotes: Reads only text immediately around the caret for the active dash replacement.
Does not post, upload, open a remote service, or transmit composer text.
No automatic posting path is declared.

blockers.reason: Cumulative QA and explicit maintainer publication approval remain pending.

packages.name: Meme Maker
packages.summary: Reviewed maker and generator entry points planned for the Composer Kit package.

notes: External-open and caption handoff infrastructure exists, but the Composer Kit package artifact and maker-specific review are not complete.
No package hash or availability claim will be created by issue #181.

capabilities: Open a reviewed maker after explicit user action.
Prepare bounded caption text only through a declared host-mediated handoff.
Keep generated-media review and any later copy, save, attach, or post action separate.

notes: No maker origins or host permissions are approved by this unavailable record.

siteScopes: X/Twitter composer-adjacent controls only after explicit activation

notes: No maker captions, generated media, or source-page data are granted storage by this record.

privacyNotes: No maker destination is approved by this unavailable record.
A future package must disclose each external origin and exactly what explicit caption data leaves the extension.
Selecting a maker never posts, uploads, attaches, or mutates an account.

blockers.reason: Maker destinations, package UX, disclosures, and explicit media review remain under feature review.
Current release policy places Meme Maker inside the single Composer Kit package and requires integrated shared QA.
